sections.title: GM03 Query Contract
sections.text: See docs/ENTITY_QUERIES.md for the complete version-1 input/output grammar, frame directions and native operator handoff. Uses the same resolver as extended entity.find and model.fillet/chamfer.query. Read-only, no activation, recompute, selection changes or save. Scope supports component definitions, exact full occurrence paths, bodies and features; instances:true retains nested/repeated physical instances. Missing properties exclude requested filters and remain unknown in statistics.

sections.title: Return Contract And Acceptance
sections.text: result contains schemaVersion,success,status,documentIdentity,entities,refs,count,candidateCount,rejected,ambiguous,expect,groups,statistics,units,frame,associativity:snapshot,affected:[],warnings,method,limitations,provenance.query. Descriptions are reusable refs with analytic properties and per-row actual frame. expect count/range failure preserves matches and returns status:fail, causing nonzero CLI exit. unique:true is count=1 here; stats always returns the aggregate shape. No first-match fallback. Re-run after topology, pose or parameter changes; no native future-selection association is claimed. Offline fixture coverage does not close native acceptance.

sections.title: Attribute Predicates
sections.text: filters.attributes is a nonempty AND-list of {group,name,value,owner} objects. group/name are nonempty; value is an exact string comparison including the empty string; owner is required (native/proxy/occurrence) with no fallback between stores. native reads the nativeObject/native definition, proxy the exact contextual proxy, occurrence the candidate occurrence or its exact assemblyContext. A missing store or a differing value is a nonmatch reported in rejected[].reasons; a structurally invalid predicate is a preflight error before enumeration. Proxy/occurrence predicates require an occurrence scope, kind:occurrence, or instances:true and are unavailable on component candidates. Hiding an entity does not exclude it. Statistics report unknown measurements as null, never zero. See docs/ENTITY_QUERIES.md.

examples.label: Group short edges by body
examples.requires: Open target Design; current native body topology. Zero matches is explicitly allowed.
examples.output: result.groups[].statistics.length contains count/missing/min/max/sum/mean in cm. No measurements becomes null, never zero.

examples.label: Count physical bodies by native attribute
examples.requires: Open Design document; write the fmcad.metadata/role attribute on the body's native definition with entity.attribute.set first. stats keeps its aggregate shape even when the expectation fails.
examples.output: result.statistics reports count/missing/min/max/sum/mean for radius/length/area/volume; result.groups[].count groups matches by occurrence; result.rejected[].reasons lists nonmatches.

verified: Analytic and interval filters, count diagnostics, scoped enumeration and one-hop adjacency
Namespaced attribute predicates across native/proxy/occurrence owners, missing-value nonmatch, malformed preflight, occurrence-context requirements and hidden-body retention
Nested native-transform composition, frame inverses and rigid guards
Current-topology enumeration and pre-mutation modeling seed capture
